intent_and_evidence: The API obtains a WarehouseRepository through FastAPI dependency injection, and the repository encapsulates warehouse database operations through the Database abstraction.
The API injects InventoryRepository and delegates inventory operations to it. The repository stores the Database abstraction and performs database access through it.
The API injects OrderRepository and delegates order operations to it. The repository encapsulates database queries through the Database abstraction.
The API obtains TransportationRepository through dependency injection and delegates transportation operations to it. The repository performs vehicle, driver, route, and shipment database operations.
